wipedata.title: Delete your data?
wipedata.intro: This permanently deletes your data in this server:
wipedata.body: Your to-do list, reminders and stored login token are the same in every server, so they are deleted everywhere. Without the login token the bot can no longer add you to the support server; Verify with Discord stores a new one. Moderation, appeal, report and verification records are kept.

item.oauth: Stored Discord login token (from Verify with Discord)
item.dmlog: Saved copies of bot DMs (to re-translate them when you change language)
item.ticketRatings: Ticket ratings you gave (your name and comment; the stars stay)

wipedata.partialFailed: The database did not respond for: {items}.
wipedata.partialRetry: Run /wipedata again in a few minutes.
wipedata.done:
Deleted: {items}.
Levels and birthday in this server; to-do list, reminders and the stored login token everywhere.

Moderation, appeal, report and verification records are kept, because they are the server's safety records. See the Privacy Policy for how to ask about those.
wipedata.failed: The database is not responding. Nothing may have been deleted; try again in a few minutes.
